positive_snippets: Nice place to stay either on day basis or monthly basis if you visiting or working near DLF Cyber City in Gurugram.

Property is located in U-Block at a walking distance of dlf cyber hub. Rooms are good, clean and budget friendly. Although there is lack of maintenance seen for couple of things in the room and around. It is good place for people having hybrid office and have to visit office for few days.  Plenty of parking and a lot of eating options available around

I came from Bangalore and found this room on Google. The photos uploaded looked fine. I visited the hotel on Tuesday, February 4, 2025, and stayed in Room 202 on the second floor. However, I found that the walls of the room were peeling, and the bedsheets and blankets were damaged. I requested a room change in the morning. Later that evening, February 5, 2025, I moved to Room 205 on the second floor.

When I saw the new room, I immediately requested the reception to change the blanket cover and bedsheets because they were torn and had hair on them. Additionally, the bathroom was not properly cleaned. Unfortunately, the staff’s behavior was very rude and unprofessional. They spoke to me with a lot of attitude and responded rudely when I asked for assistance.

I had originally booked the hotel for Friday and was planning to extend my stay for an additional six days, but now I am unsure. This is why I am writing this feedback, hoping you will consider it. If you need any further details or clarification, please feel free to contact me. I am available to answer any questions.

Additionally, the staff informed me that they only have torn blankets and bedsheets and have not been supportive in replacing them.

Thank you.
